verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents running automated tests of robot software in CI, or running simulation-based regression suites. Viam does offer a cloud-simulated machine for hands-on configuring and testing without hardware, a fake/dummy RDK configuration, and a simulation course. These are building blocks for interactive or onboarding use, not a documented CI or regression-testing capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run automated tests of robot software in CI, including simulation-based regression tests
